title: Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi urges citizens to download the Mission Shakti App for Quick Access to Key Helpline Services for Women and Children
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi urges citizens to download the Mission Shakti App for Quick Access to Key Helpline Services for Women and Children

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
31 JUL 2026 11:20AM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister of Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi has urged citizens to download the Mission Shakti App, which brings safety and assistance for women and children just a click away.

In a post on 'X' the Union Minister said that the Mission Shakti App further strengthens the Government's resolve towards the safety, assistance and empowerment of women and children. She stated that the App ensures quick and easy access to important helpline services on a single platform, including Women Helpline 181, Emergency Service 112, Poshan and PMMVY Helpline 1515, National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930, Legal Aid (NALSA) 15100, Tele-MANAS 14416 and Child Helpline 1098.

She appealed to everyone to download the Mission Shakti App and share information about these important services with their families and acquaintances.

महिलाओं एवं बच्चों की सुरक्षा, सहायता और सशक्तिकरण के हमारे संकल्प को और मजबूत बनाता है मिशन शक्ति ऐप। इसके माध्यम से महत्वपूर्ण हेल्पलाइन सेवाओं तक त्वरित और आसान पहुंच सुनिश्चित की गई है।
